title.value: Political Reform Act of 1974 (amends Government Code Sections 84504.3, 84504.4 and 84510; adds Sections 84503.5 and 84504.6)

citations.quote: An act to amend Sections 84504.3, 84504.4, and 84510 of, and to add Sections 84503.5 and 84504.6 to, the Government Code, relating to the Political Reform Act of 1974.
